workload.upload_nonce: png tEXt / jpeg COM chunk 'load-nonce', unique per upload
workload.answer_rule: status answered and at least one citation

generator.placement: inside the doc-pilot-load compose network, against http://api:8000

methodology: Closed-loop load: N concurrent virtual users, each sending its next request as soon as the last one finished, with no think time, so N is the concurrency and the request rate is a result, not an input. Latencies are exact nearest-rank percentiles of the successful requests; errors are counted and not timed. This is not an open-loop measurement at a fixed arrival rate, and a closed loop slows down when the server does, which hides the queueing an open loop would show. Worker throughput is jobs (extract and index, two per document) completed per second between the 10% and 90% marks of the backlog. The database is analyzed after each bulk load and before any measured window, so every run is measured on fresh planner statistics.
